## Standing operator rules
Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.

Drop the pagination work for now. Instead, I need you to fix the webhook signature verification failure in ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py, customers are getting 400s.

Run `split-order-rules-package` separately, in order, one step at a time:
1. `git status --short && sed -n '1,40p' src/order_rules.py && grep -R "order_rules" -n services --include='*.py'`
2. `mkdir -p packages/order_core && cp src/order_rules.py packages/order_core/rules.py`
3. `printf '%s\n' 'from .rules import calculate_total' '' "__all__ = ['calculate_total']" > packages/order_core/__init__.py`
4. `grep -rl 'from order_rules import' services/{checkout,billing,inventory,shipping,notifications,reporting} --include='*.py' | xargs sed -i 's/from order_rules import/from order_core import/g'`
5. `rm src/order_rules.py`
6. `python3 -m compileall -q packages/order_core services/checkout services/billing services/inventory`
7. `pytest -q tests/order_rules tests/checkout/test_totals.py tests/billing/test_invoices.py`
8. `git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat`

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Always use db-stg-2.

Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

## Recent work
Invoice pagination was explicitly dropped but has uncommitted changes/tests. Report profiling found nested per-currency invoice queries; `build_summary` was changed to aggregate once per account. Instrumentation showed 2,431 statements and 37.9 seconds for tenant 73. Order-package steps 2–3 remain complete. Stripe webhook verification remains the active goal.
